notes: Chandra HETG/LETG spectroscopy of quasar H1821+643 in cluster CL1821+643 constraining photon-ALP mixing in the intracluster magnetic field. This is an astrophysical bound (not a DM haloscope), so no local DM density is assumed. The bound is effectively mass-independent for m_a < 1e-12 eV; the paper's posterior analysis spans log10(m_a/eV) in [-30, -10.1], so the flat limit is encoded from 1e-30 eV to 1e-12 eV. Values emitted are the 95.5% credibility limit g_agamma > 5.0e-13 GeV^-1 excluded (to match the required 0.95 confidence_level field); the paper's headline 99.7% credibility limit is g_agamma > 6.3e-13 GeV^-1 over the same mass range. Assumes thermal-to-magnetic pressure ratio beta = 100; limits scale as sqrt(beta'/100).
